AN EXAMPLE COMPUTING SYSTEM

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS
FIG. 1 illustrates a block diagram of the system 100.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION
The system 100 includes a sensor 120 and a controller 130. The sensor 120 communicates measurement data to the controller 130.

As shown in FIG. 1, the system 100 contains the sensor 120 and the controller 130.

CLAIMS
1. A system comprising a sensor and a controller.
